chapters":[1,2,3,4,5,6],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":8,"returned":8},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-6","sourceManifest":"manifest:3739db56713af694","knowledgeRevision":6,"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":114},"contentHash":"d0f3a8d6ed8fc2fd84a9f3d1ec3405b033a5c2569861939f2e493649de3dc8f2"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":3,"text":"看到这个问题的第一瞬间，苏天晴脑子里出现了昨天晚上的场景："},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":6,"text":"但苏天晴自己也很清楚，昨天那样的状况完全是借助强化后的黑狼怪人才实现的，并非自己的真正实力。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":12,"text":"反复翻阅着秘典，看着那一行惊心动魄的盒打击，苏天晴心里冒出了一个危险的想法。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":17,"text":"“看来只能花些神典石来消灾了呢。”苏天晴呢喃自语。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":25,"text":"没有丝毫犹豫，在用一声疑惑的轻呼表达了心中困惑后，苏天晴果断将它买下。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":30,"text":"可即便解决了第二个任务的前置，“如何让魔法少女窘迫”这个问题依然像个梦魇一样萦绕在苏天晴脑子里。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":37,"text":"苏天晴的目光继续下滑。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":41,"text":"苏天晴捏着下巴，尾巴左右摇摆，陷入沉思。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":45,"text":"苏天晴眼珠子一转。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"chapters":[1,2,3,4,5,6],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":fa
